notes: GET /savingsaccounts/{id}/paymentchannels returns every product channel, including isActive false, plus subscriptionStatus, allowedForDeposit, blocked, blockedOnDate, and charges. POST ?command=subscribe|unsubscribe|block|unblock sends { paymentTypeId }. Block does not unsubscribe. Omitting a product channel on PUT soft-disables it; send isActive false to keep the row and turn it off.
